tags.description: Great road with no holes. Lots of corners with elevation changes but no visibility. Only 1 lane - you need to go off-road to let another car pass. Good for touge during the late night.

tags.note: classification in osm prefers the importance of a road over its official statusfor routing purposes. This road is only locally important an no transit route, so classifying it as primary is inadequate and would result probably in wrong routing!
